mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, help_code, sex, age, price, attention, img, create_time FROM t_setmeal WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY price ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, number, reservations, (number - reservations) AS availableCount FROM t_ordersetting WHERE order_date >= CURDATE() AND reservations < number ORDER BY order_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ordersetting SET reservations = reservations + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_date = #{orderDate} AND reservations < number
UPDATE t_ordersetting SET reservations = reservations - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_date = #{orderDate} AND reservations > 0
